observations: Two tires stacked vertically, tread facing camera, both appear similar tread pattern.
Yellow paint/chalk marks and some yellow pen writing on both tires, typical of grading marks used by importers.
A hand rests on the top tire, apparently for scale, no measurement tool shown.
No sidewall text (brand, size, DOT date) is visible in the photo; only tread face is shown.
Background shows a tire shop or roadside stall with other tire stacks and signage.

claims.evidence: No sidewall visible in photo 0; size cannot be confirmed from tread-only shot.
Yellow marks may be grading marks but no legible grading system or certificate shown; tread depth and sidewall condition not fully visible.

risks.risk: Tire size mismatch with buyer's vehicle (215/60/17C stated but unconfirmed)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of sidewall showing size, load index, and speed rating
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/generic size, cannot match specific fitment

risks.risk: Tire age (old rubber can be hard/cracked despite good tread)
risks.proof: Photo of DOT date code on sidewall (4-digit week/year stamp)
risks.if_unproven: priced as old/aged stock, worst case for longevity

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, bulges, or repairs
risks.proof: Full 360° sidewall photos of both tires, inner and outer
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible structural damage

risks.risk: Tread depth not independently verified (hand-on-tire is not a measurement)
risks.proof: Photo with tread depth gauge or coin inserted in groove
risks.if_unproven: priced as minimum legal tread depth, not premium

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, affects resale value and quality tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of sidewall brand logo and model name

proof_requests: Clear sidewall photo showing size (215/60/17C), brand, and model
Close-up of DOT date code for tire age
Full sidewall photos (inner and outer) for both tires showing no cracks or bulges
Tread depth measurement with gauge or ruler at multiple points
response.reason: The single tread-only photo does not show the sidewall, so size, brand, and age (all critical to price) cannot be confirmed, and even a worst-case price requires knowing the stated size is genuine.
